name: com.nayuraikar.semanticvr
description: Lighting-aware, stereo-consistent semantic recolouring for colour-vision-deficient users in VR.

samples.description: Signalised street crossing: traffic signals (FSM), road signs, cars, grass, sky, hazard flashers.
Railway station: rail signals, level-crossing flashers and a departure/status board, all FSM-driven.
Airliner flight deck: master warning/caution, annunciator panel, PFD/ND colour coding and a runway with PAPI and edge lights.
ICU bay: patient monitor with alarm banners and traces, medical-gas cylinders, drug labels, infusion pump, skin and cyanosis tint.
Shopping street with Day and Night lighting presets (N): painted and neon signs whose deutan confusability depends on the lighting.
